build_escnmd_moe_backbone: build an eSCNMDMoeBackbone model with configurable number of experts and MOLE layer settings
merge_mole_model_backbone: merge the eSCNMDMoeBackbone MOLE experts into a single linear layer for inference on one dataset
create_dataset_specific_moe_wrapper: create a DatasetSpecificMoEWrapper that routes predictions through dataset-specific MOLE experts in the head
create_dataset_specific_single_head_wrap: create a DatasetSpecificSingleHeadWrapper that shares one head across multiple datasets with output routing
review_mole_coefficient_routing: review the set_MOLE_coefficients method that computes expert mixing coefficients from composition and CSD embeddings
